opening.argument: The video presents a police arrest as a news report. A Jamuna TV anchor appears at a studio desk, footage shows a woman beside a uniformed officer in a police-station corridor, and another officer speaks during the report. The description reports Farzana Begum's arrest in Chittagong, while the title frames the story as an extortion-related case. Those allegations are the subject of the coverage, not an offer or request for money, investment, credentials, or participation. The broadcaster's social-media links appear as a separate invitation to stay connected, with no connection shown to the reported conduct. Nothing in the cited material establishes losses or an outcome beyond the reported arrest.
